title: Time Spent
settingEnableLogDesc: Output time tracking and debug logs in the developer console (disabled by default)
settingOpenInTabDesc: Open dashboard in a new tab when clicking the top bar icon, otherwise open in a modal dialog (enabled by default)
settingOpenInTabDisabledMsg: Set to open in modal dialog
settingsGroupAiDesc: Configure LLM API service, support local settings or management by API Switcher (siyuan-api-switch).
settingsAiProviderDescription: LLM provider name, e.g. openai, anthropic.
settingsAiBaseUrlDescription: Base URL of the API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.
settingsAiApiKeyDescription: LLM API Key, usually Bearer Key.
settingsAiModelDescription: Current LLM model name, e.g. gpt-4o.
settingsAiRequestTimeoutSecondsDescripti: Timeout limit for LLM API requests in seconds (5-300), default is 30.
settingsAiTemperatureDescription: Sampling temperature (0-2), higher values mean more creative output, default is 0.7.
settingsAiMaxTokensDescription: Max tokens limit for generating content, default is 4096.
settingsAiControlledHint: 💡 General AI API is currently controlled by API Switcher (siyuan-api-switch){profile}. Related inputs are read-only. Please configure in API Switcher.
